description: Synthetic 2-page MinerU content_list_v2 (list of pages, each a list of blocks) on the fixed 1000x1000 canvas; English biology paper. Uses real v2 field names (title_content+level, paragraph_content with equation_inline items, equation_interline math_content/math_type/image_source, table image_source/table_caption/table_footnote/html/table_type/table_nest_level, image image_source/image_caption/image_footnote, list list_type/list_items/item_content, code code_caption/code_content/code_language/code_footnote, page_header/page_footer/page_number). Margins 80-110 left/right, ~38-85 top, ~28 bottom; all bboxes positive area and inside the canvas.

features.expect: same normalized result as level 1 (heading); level dropped; also [0][7], [1][1]
kind=table, text empty, translate=false; html/caption/footnote/image_source not present in normalized doc
kind=image, text empty, translate=false; path/caption/footnote not present
kind=text, layout list_item, translate=true; items flattened into one space-joined line

features.feature: code block with caption and language
features.expect: kind=code, text kept (code_content), translate=false; code_caption/code_language dropped

tricky_points: Captions/footnotes of table, image and code live inside the container's content, not as sibling blocks, so the adapter never sees them as caption/footnote blocks.
Inline equation items carry no $ delimiters; text and formula segments are stripped and joined with single spaces, so original spacing (e.g. 'constant \tau of', '2 \mu M') is not preserved.
List items are flattened: item boundaries lost, content.line_texts has a single entry.
Title level 1 and 2 normalize identically (both 'heading'; never document_title).
Display equation and inline equations coexist; inline formulas use raw LaTeX in 'text'.
Code line_texts are stripped (indentation lost) though block text keeps it.
Whole-block bbox is copied to every segment/line/span (bbox_precision block/block_fallback).
Rescale: 1000x1000 canvas mapped to 612x792 so x scale 0.612, y scale 0.792 (non-uniform).
